card.name: Premiere and first performance of works
card.fires_on: The word premiere (or premier) and nearby words like first performed, in or of, when describing when and where a musical or stage work was first presented. Also fires faintly on rights-granting verbs like sell in a patent passage.

modes.label: Premiere wording
modes.description: The word premiere or premier for the first public showing of an opera or symphony.
modes.example: the Metropolitan Opera gave the world<< premier>> of an opera by the most famous living

modes.label: First performed in place or year
modes.description: Words after first performed, such as performed, in, or of, leading to a place or date.
modes.example: With his tone poems Amazonas (1916, first<< performed>> in Paris in 1929

modes.label: Patent rights verbs
modes.description: A verb in a list of exclusive rights in a patent passage.
modes.example: exclusive rights to make,<< sell>> and license their invention
